column4: dialect-gated: cleat#3740 measurement, SQL Server arm of the definition-read scope test (the PostgreSQL arms are engine/a_store_reads_only_its_own_tenants_definition_test.go and the two cleat-worker tests beside it). This job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) supplies no SQL Server, so exactly this function skips. It FAILS rather than skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set and the server is unreachable (mssqlHBRig pings it). Measured by name: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestASQLServerStoreReadsOnlyItsOwnTenantsDefinition -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one.
